rules.title: No hardcoded visual values in component CSS
rules.description: All colors, spacing, radius, shadow, and typography values must reference --notification-toast-* tokens, not raw hex, rgba, px, or rem literals.
rules.check: CSS component selectors must not contain hex colors, rgba(), raw px spacing, or hardcoded font-size values outside of var() expressions.

rules.title: Root element must not be interactive
rules.description: The .notification-toast root element must be a <div>, not a <button>, <a>, or other interactive element.

rules.title: Root must carry role=alert or role=status
rules.description: Every .notification-toast element must carry role=alert or role=status as a live region announcement mechanism.
rules.check: document.querySelectorAll('.notification-toast') must all have getAttribute('role') equal to 'alert' or 'status'.

rules.title: Type modifier class must be present
rules.description: Every .notification-toast must carry exactly one type modifier: .notification-toast--neutral, --info, --critical-error, --warning, or --success.
rules.check: document.querySelectorAll('.notification-toast') must all have at least one class matching /notification-toast--(neutral|info|critical-error|warning|success)/.

rules.title: Close button must have aria-label
rules.description: The .notification-toast__close button must carry a non-empty aria-label.
rules.check: document.querySelectorAll('.notification-toast__close') must all have a non-empty getAttribute('aria-label').

rules.title: Icon SVG must be aria-hidden
rules.description: The SVG inside .notification-toast__icon-wrap must carry aria-hidden=true.

rules.title: Close button icon must be aria-hidden
rules.description: The .btn__icon span inside .notification-toast__close must carry aria-hidden=true.

rules.title: Action buttons must have visible text
rules.description: Each .btn inside .notification-toast__actions must have a non-empty .btn__text element.
rules.check: document.querySelectorAll('.notification-toast__actions .btn') must all contain a .btn__text with non-empty textContent.

rules.title: No physical directional properties in component CSS
rules.description: Component CSS must use logical properties (padding-inline, inset-inline-end) instead of physical directional properties (padding-left, right) for RTL compatibility.
rules.check: notification-toast.css must not contain padding-left, padding-right, margin-left, margin-right, left:, right: in component selectors (except in [dir='rtl'] overrides if needed).

rules.title: All template classes must exist in component CSS
rules.description: Every CSS class used in template.html must be defined in notification-toast.css. No orphan template classes.
rules.check: Extract all class names from template.html. Each must appear in notification-toast.css.

rules.title: No orphan CSS selectors
rules.description: Every CSS selector in notification-toast.css must correspond to a class used in template.html or be a valid state/modifier selector.
rules.check: Extract all selectors from notification-toast.css. Verify each base class name appears in template.html.

rules.title: Lead text must not be empty
rules.description: The .notification-toast__lead element must contain non-empty text content.
